note: The alarm table of docs/rebuild/v1/production-hosting.md section 15 as data. Rows with source 'readiness' are evaluated by core.readiness (GET /health/ready/, loopback only) and gate the outside-host heartbeat; every other row is configured outside the application (CloudWatch, EventBridge, Route 53, Healthchecks.io) and is listed here so the table, the readiness check and their test read one source. Thresholds are operational defaults, overridable by the named setting; none is a retention period.

alarms.condition: the single worker's last completed loop pass is older than the threshold, or was never recorded
alarms.basis: twice core.admin_console.STALENESS_BOUND: one pass may wait out a single provider request up to that bound

alarms.condition: the oldest queued job has waited longer than the threshold
alarms.basis: core.admin_console.STALENESS_BOUND, the bound processing_health already calls a queue that is not draining

alarms.condition: more jobs are queued than the threshold
alarms.basis: an operational ceiling for one worker; raise it with measured throughput

alarms.condition: core.admin_console.processing_health reports severity 'error' (no worker has run recently, or the queue is not draining)
StatusCheckFailed_System -> alarm plus EC2 auto-recover action; StatusCheckFailed_Instance -> alarm
mem_used_percent > 85% for 10 min; disk used_percent > 80% on / or the state root; swap used > 0
UnHealthyHostCount >= 1 for 5 min; target 5XX > 10 in 5 min; p95 target response > 10 s
CPU > 80% 15 min; FreeStorageSpace < 20%; FreeableMemory < 256 MiB; event subscription for failures, low storage, backup and maintenance
AWS Backup job FAILED/EXPIRED/ABORTED and copy-job failures
root or break-glass sign-in, KMS disable/deletion scheduling, vault/bucket policy change, security group change, GuardDuty findings of medium or higher

Healthchecks.io check fed by quillmd-production-heartbeat.timer every 5 minutes (only after both surfaces answer /health/ with 200 and the doctor surface answers /health/ready/ with 200), period 5 min, grace 10 min, alerting both custodians outside AWS; Route 53 health check on https://app.quillmd.com/health/ with a CloudWatch alarm
